Sun Peaks Resort
55 That portion of M.U. 3-27 in the vicinity of Kamloops, KDYD, which is contained within the following described boundaries: All land and waters within 400 metres of any ski lift, run, facility or development of the Sun Peaks Resort. [en. B.C. Reg. 322/95, s. 2 (b).]
